summary: The task loop system successfully executed all 8 tasks with 100% success rate. Architecture transformation completed as foundational one-time task. However, critical gaps identified: Architecture.md integration missing, one-time task tracking absent, and artifact storage not organized. System is operationally ready but security and architectural compliance gaps prevent production deployment.
agreements: Current loop system executed 8/8 tasks with 100% success rate
Architecture transformation completed successfully as foundational one-time task
Clear classification established: one-time tasks (8) vs looping tasks (4)
Task execution sequencing and validation working properly
Artifact generation established with complete audit trail
disagreements: Architecture.md integration needs explicit validation for security compliance
One-time task tracking missing - tasks may be re-executed wastefully
Artifact storage not organized - no dedicated loop-specific subfolders
Future task integration requires manual framework - increases error risk
open_questions: What's the exact integration requirement between tasks and architecture.md?
What specific artifact structure is needed for loop validation and security?
How should completed one-time tasks be tracked across loops to prevent re-execution?
Should task-doc-update be moved to looping tasks or remain one-time?
recommendation: Immediate security and architectural compliance gaps must be addressed before production deployment: 1) Implement architecture.md integration validation, 2) Add one-time task tracking system, 3) Create dedicated loop-specific artifact storage. System is operationally ready but security-blocked.
